context:
Goal: a holdings value report that prices as much of your roster as it can.
Problem (goal): the report shipped on main today (PR 1024) with the name join, which prices under half the roster; switching reopens a settled decision, so it needs your word.
Based on (read): D324 says the join is set plus normalized product name, and its Reopen line says "or a better join than names appears".
Based on (measured): the holdings lane (2026-11-02): joining by product id prices 839 of 893 roster lines; the name join prices 373.
home: D324 (the holdings report), on main via PR 1025

options.gain: About 94% of lines priced instead of 42%.
options.how: Reopen D324 and join the roster on product id.
options.label: Switch to the product id join

options.how: D324 stands; the report keeps joining on set and name.
options.label: Keep the name join
options.lose: Over half the roster stays unpriced.

ref: D324 (Banchi values the owner's investment holdings); PR 1024 (holdings value report)
title: Value your investment roster by product id instead of by name?
why: It prices more than twice as many lines, and D324's own Reopen line expects this.
